children: Algonquin Power & Utilities agreed to sell its ownership stake in Suralis S.A., a Chilean water utility, to a fund managed by Toesca S.A. Administradora General de Fondos.
The sale covers Algonquin's stake of roughly 64%. The company said it expects to receive $126.5 million in proceeds from the sale, plus an earnout opportunity of up to $1.5 million.
Algonquin said it will use the proceeds to pay down its debts and facilitate capital recycling into its 2026-2028 capital plan.

"This transaction represents an important step in simplifying our geographic footprint while concurrently recycling capital into our core regulated utility businesses," Algonquin Chief Executive Rod West said.
The deal is expected to close in the next two quarters.
